question:
What percentage of clients who opened their accounts in the district with an average salary of over 10000 are women?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Female refers to gender = 'F'; Woman and female are closed; Average salary can be found in A11

prediction.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_010 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM client AS "c" JOIN disp AS "d" ON "d".XCL_014 = "c".XCL_009 JOIN account AS "a" ON "a".XCL_001 = "d".XCL_015 JOIN district AS "di" ON "di".XCL_017 = "a".XCL_002 WHERE di.XCL_027 > 10000

arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_010 = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN account a ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN district di ON di.XCL_017 = a.XCL_002
WHERE di.XCL_027 > 10000;
